title: How far a readout may travel to find whitespace is tuned with the user
goal: A measurement number now steps sideways up to three of its own heights to get off the elements it is describing, on a connector line. Confirm with the user that this distance feels right on dense captures, and tune it (or make it depend on the connector length) if a 100 px hop reads as a different measurement.
notes: Comes from queue/audits/2026-09-02-caliper-subjects.json rough item 2 and 2026-08-23-size-readout-placement rough item 2. Only worth doing after the user reacts to the audit; drop if they are happy.
acceptance: The user has seen the field-to-buttons example from the caliper subjects audit and given a verdict on the travel distance.
The limit in MeasureLabelPlanner.maxCrossReach reflects that verdict and the planner tests pin it.
